description: Use this when someone asks when a patient is booked or what is booked on a day, or an appointment id is needed to move or cancel it. Returns up to 50 appointments in start order with id, patient and provider ids, times, status and edit time, for one day or one patient. Not for counting how busy days are, nor for procedures, notes or clinical details.

clinicId.description: Only this practice; every practice of the account when absent

endTime.description: End of the window. Without a patientId at most one day after the start, and one day by default; with one at most a year, and 90 days by default

patientId.description: Only this patient, by the id find_patient returns

startTime.description: Start of the window as an ISO 8601 time with the practice's UTC offset; defaults to now

name: list_appointments

appointments.description: Appointments in start order, canceled ones included, that the signed-in account can view. Procedures, notes, findings, treatments and patient names are never returned.

lastEditTime.description: The version reschedule_appointment and cancel_appointment check

providerIds.description: The list_clinic_providers ids of the staff booked on it

hasMore.description: More appointments fall in the window than were returned

title: Find appointments
